prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案。
text: It is said that the artist died in poverty. = The artist is said _____ in poverty.
options: to have died
to die
having died

wrong.to die: is said to die 表示「據說會死」，與說的時間同時或未來；死亡發生在更早之前，要用 to have died。
wrong.having died: is said 後面不能直接接 having died，要用不定詞完成式 to have died。

why: 動作比 is said 更早發生時，用 to have + 過去分詞。
tip: 早於 is said 的動作：to have + p.p.
say: The artist is said to have died in poverty.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案。
text: The old bridge is expected _____ next year.
options: to be repaired
to repair
repairing

wrong.to repair: 橋不會自己修，是被修理，要用被動 to be repaired。
wrong.repairing: is expected 後面要接不定詞，不接 -ing。

why: 橋是被修理的對象，所以用不定詞的被動形式 to be + 過去分詞。
tip: 主詞是受動者：to be + p.p.
say: The old bridge is expected to be repaired next year.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: It is reported that the factory has closed.
It reported that the factory has closed.
It is reporting that the factory has closed.
answer: It is reported that the factory has closed.

這裡的 it 是虛主詞，不是人，不能主動報導，要用被動 is reported。
wrong.It is reporting that the factory has clo: 進行式表示正在報導的動作，語意不自然；客觀報導常用被動 is reported。

why: It is reported that ... 是無靈主詞的被動句型，用來客觀陳述消息。
tip: It is + p.p. + that 子句：客觀陳述。
say: It is reported that the factory has closed.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: The printer is being repaired right now, so please use another one.
The printer is repairing right now, so please use another one.
The printer has repaired right now, so please use another one.
answer: The printer is being repaired right now, so please use another one.

wrong.The printer is repairing right now, so p: 印表機不會修理自己，是被人修，要用進行式被動 is being repaired。
wrong.The printer has repaired right now, so p: has repaired 是主動完成式，而且 right now 表示正在進行，語意不合。

why: 正在進行中的被動動作，用 is / are + being + 過去分詞。
say: The printer is being repaired right now, so please use another one.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案。
options: be announced
announce
be announcing

wrong.announce: 結果不會自己宣布，是被宣布，要用被動語態。
wrong.be announcing: will be announcing 是主動進行式，主詞 results 無法主動宣布。

why: 未來被動語態是 will be + 過去分詞，這裡主詞是結果，所以 be announced。
say: The results will be announced next week.

prompt: “The suspect is believed to have fled the country.” 是什麼意思？
options: 據信嫌犯已經逃出這個國家。
嫌犯相信自己將會逃出國。
據信嫌犯會留在國內。
answer: 據信嫌犯已經逃出這個國家。

wrong.嫌犯相信自己將會逃出國。: is believed 是「被相信」，相信的人不是嫌犯，而且 to have fled 是已經逃走。

why: is believed to have + p.p. 表示「據信已經…」。
tip: is believed to have p.p.：據信已經…
say: The suspect is believed to have fled the country.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案。
text: Nothing could _____ done to save the old theatre.
options: be
have
being

wrong.have: could have done 是主動；這裡 nothing 是被做的對象，要用 could be done。
wrong.being: could 後面要接原形動詞，不能直接接 being。

why: 情態助動詞的被動語態是 could / can + be + 過去分詞。
tip: 情態助動詞被動：can / could be p.p.
say: Nothing could be done to save the old theatre.

prompt: 你在寫正式公告，想客觀地說明「會議被決定延期」，哪一句最合適？
options: It was decided that the meeting would be postponed.
It decided that the meeting would be postponed.
It was decide that the meeting is postponed.
answer: It was decided that the meeting would be postponed.

wrong.It decided that the meeting would be pos: it 不能自己做決定，要用被動 It was decided。
wrong.It was decide that the meeting is postpo: 被動要用過去分詞 decided，而且 would be 才與過去式 was 配合。

why: It was decided that ... 以被動表達客觀的決定，不特別指出是誰決定。
tip: It was + p.p. that ...：客觀的官方語氣。
say: It was decided that the meeting would be postponed.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: English is spoken in many countries.
English is speaking in many countries.
English speaks in many countries.
answer: English is spoken in many countries.

英語是被人使用的，不是正在說話，要用被動 is spoken。
English 不會主動說話，應是被動，speaks 不通。

why: 語言是被人使用的，所以用被動 is spoken。
say: English is spoken in many countries.

prompt: “It is widely assumed that sleep helps memory.” 這句話傳達了什麼？
options: 這是許多人的普遍看法，不是說話者本人直接證明的。
說話者親自做實驗證明睡眠有助記憶。
說話者反對睡眠有助記憶的說法。
answer: 這是許多人的普遍看法，不是說話者本人直接證明的。

wrong.說話者親自做實驗證明睡眠有助記憶。: is assumed 表示被假定，不是說話者自己證明的結果。
wrong.說話者反對睡眠有助記憶的說法。: 句中沒有反對的語氣，只是敘述一般人的看法。

why: It is assumed that ... 表示「一般認為」，是客觀陳述普遍看法。
tip: It is assumed that：一般認為…
say: It is widely assumed that sleep helps memory.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案。
text: It is difficult for me _____ early.
options: to get up
getting up
get up

wrong.getting up: for me 後面要接不定詞，不接 -ing。
wrong.get up: for me 後面接 to V，不能直接用原形動詞。

why: It is + 形容詞 + for + 人 + to V 是虛主詞 it 的常用句型。
tip: It is adj for 人 to V。
say: It is difficult for me to get up early.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: I found it hard to concentrate in the noisy room.
I found hard to concentrate in the noisy room.
I found it hardly to concentrate in the noisy room.
answer: I found it hard to concentrate in the noisy room.

wrong.I found hard to concentrate in the noisy: found 後面缺受詞，要用 it 當虛受詞，真正受詞 to concentrate 放後面。
wrong.I found it hardly to concentrate in the: hardly 是「幾乎不」的副詞，補語要用形容詞 hard。

why: find + it + 形容詞 + to V，it 是虛受詞，to V 是真正受詞。
tip: find it hard to V：覺得做…很難。
say: I found it hard to concentrate in the noisy room.

prompt: “The cave is said to have been used by sailors.” 是什麼意思？
options: 據說這個洞穴以前曾被水手使用過。
據說水手將來會使用這個洞穴。
據說水手造了這個洞穴。
answer: 據說這個洞穴以前曾被水手使用過。

wrong.據說水手將來會使用這個洞穴。: to have been used 是過去的事，不是將來。
wrong.據說水手造了這個洞穴。: 句中是 used（使用），不是建造。

why: is said to have been + p.p. 表示「據說過去曾被…」。
tip: to have been p.p.：過去曾被…
say: The cave is said to have been used by sailors.
